tooltip.dungeons_reborn.artifact.iron_hi:
The Iron Hide Amulet is both ancient and
timeless. Sand mysteriously and endlessly
slips through the cracks in the iron.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.artifact.death_c:
Eaten by daring warriors before battle, the
Death Cap Mushroom drives fighters into a frenzy.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.twin_bow:
The Twin Bow is the champion of the hero
who finds themselves outnumbered and alone.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.auto_crossbow:
The Arch-Illager said the design for this
powerful crossbow came to him in a vision.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.heavy_crossbow:
The weighted crossbow is a damage-dealing
menace and a real threat from a ranged distance.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.rough_diamond_sw:
The Rough Diamond Sword is the true mark
of a hero and an accomplished adventurer.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.rough_diamond_pi:
Diamond is one of the most durable materials,
making it an excellent choice for a pickaxe.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.steel_mace:
The Steel Mace is a brutal tool of war and what
it lacks in finesse; it makes up for in power.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.suns_grace:
This mace, engraved with secret healing
runes, grants powerful restorative powers.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.claymore:
A massive sword that seems impossibly heavy
yet rests easily in a just warrior's hands
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.heartstealer:
Gifted to one of the Arch-Illager's most distinguished
generals upon their conquest of the Squid Coast
- this runeblade is infused with dark witchcraft.
tooltip.dungeons_reborn.broadsword:
Only those with the strength of a champion and
the heart of a hero can carry this massive blade.
ability.dungeons_reborn.artifact.iron_hi: Provides a major boost to defense for a short time
ability.dungeons_reborn.artifact.death_c: Greatly increases attack damage and movement speed
